meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Investor management and fund administration software for private equity and real estate general partners

analysis.summary: Rivals are pushing AI and open data access. Few publish content for GPs actively switching providers, and Juniper Square has little of it too.

points.text: Agora is the only rival going after switchers, with 4 comparison pages including ones naming InvestNext and Cash Flow Portal.
InvestNext and Agora both pitch open data access (MCP, the link that lets AI tools use your data) and AI. Juniper Square's API page matches the open-access theme.
SS&C GlobalOps publishes at volume (21 new pages) on fund operations topics, mostly for readers still learning, not buying.

Allvue Systems.play: Small AI-led launch push: Nexius Studio, a loan market partnership, and an event recap.

SS&C GlobalOps.play: High-volume thought leadership and research on SMAs (separately managed accounts), 1031 exchanges, and operations outsourcing.

InvestNext.play: Refreshed product and feature pages around AI and MCP, plus brand-focused investor relations opinion pieces.

Agora.play: Big refresh of 44 pages, a weekly launch series, and many guides and comparison pages.
Agora.aimed: Real estate GPs, from research to buying

Juniper Square.play: Launches and trust signals: Capital Intelligence, APIs, a CIO hire, ISO certification, and one case study.

shared.title: Open data and AI access
shared.text: Agora and InvestNext both refreshed pages on MCP or API access to customer data. Juniper Square's new APIs page enters the same race, so message it clearly.

shared.title: Refreshing old pages over new ones
shared.text: InvestNext updated 13 pages and Agora updated 44, against 2 and 8 new. This signals a product-page and SEO refresh push, and Juniper Square is far lighter at 5 updates.

shared.title: Comparison pages against named rivals
shared.text: Agora has four alternatives pages and InvestNext has one versus Agora. Both court buyers weighing providers, a space where Juniper Square has no comparison page.

gaps.title: Switching and migration guides
gaps.text: No one publishes how to move fund admin or investor portals: timelines, data transfer, checklists. Juniper Square could own the switcher's search and fear points.

gaps.title: Customer proof from switchers
gaps.text: Juniper Square has 1 case study and Agora 1. Nobody shows before-and-after stories from GPs who changed providers, which would help GPs doing the same.

gaps.title: Private equity investor portal comparisons
gaps.text: Comparison content is real-estate focused (Agora, InvestNext). Private equity GPs get almost no head-to-head guidance, so Juniper Square could lead there.
